title: UGC Style Product Photos | AIVideosUGC
description: Make creator-style product photos for your image ads. Add one clear product photo, choose an everyday scene, and download a still without booking a creator.
h1: Make UGC Style Product Photos for Ads
lead: Make UGC-style product photos in minutes, without booking a creator or arranging a shoot. Try more everyday scenes from the same product photo.
steps_h2: How to Make a UGC Style Photo in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Start with your product, choose an everyday setting, and download a still image ready for your next image ad.

steps.d: Upload a clear image of the product you sell, or paste its product page as the starting point.
Choose a natural setting and describe how the product should appear in the still image.
Check the product and scene, then download the image for your feed or ad. One image costs 24 credits.

faq.q: Can I cancel before my next bill?
faq.a: Yes. Cancel in your account before the next billing date. Check your account for when your access ends.

faq.q: Can I use the same product photo for another market?
faq.a: Yes. Use the photo again and add text in the language your shoppers speak. You can make different scenes for each market.

faq.q: Can I change an image before downloading it?
faq.a: Yes. Change the scene or crop, then make another version if needed. Each newly generated image uses credits.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link?
faq.a: Yes. Paste a public product link to start a creator-style image. Check that the result matches the product you sell.

faq.q: Which files can I upload to start?
faq.a: Upload clear product photos or clips you have permission to use. You can also paste a public product link.

faq.q: What can I change in a creator-style photo?
faq.a: Change the setting, crop, and product placement to fit your ad. You can make another version without a new photo shoot.

faq.q: What happens if an image fails?
faq.a: The credits for a failed image return to your balance. Check your account if the balance does not update.

faq.q: Will changing plans create another credit balance?
faq.a: No. Your account shows the balance for your current plan. Check it after changing plans so you know how many credits are available.

faq.q: Does my plan include monthly credits?
faq.a: Yes. Starter includes 200 credits, Pro includes 300, and Premium includes 600 each month. Use them for images and videos.

faq.q: Can I use creator-style images in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Use downloaded images in your store, social posts, and paid ads without a watermark. Check product details before publishing.

faq.q: How many credits does a creator-style image use?
faq.a: Each image uses 24 credits. You see the cost before starting, and failed jobs return credits.

faq.q: Can I edit the image after it is made?
faq.a: Yes. Change the scene or crop and make another version. You can also turn the product photo into a video later.
Yes. Change between Starter, Pro, and Premium in your account. Check the new price and credit amount before confirming.

faq.q: What comes with a monthly plan?
faq.a: Starter includes 200 credits for $24.50, Pro includes 300 for $35, and Premium includes 600 for $63 each month. Use credits for product images and ads.

faq.q: Do unused credits carry into the next month?
faq.a: Rollover depends on your current plan terms, which you can check in your account before renewal. Credits from failed jobs return to your balance.
